pet.text: Vaporeon has quietly decided your hand is a safe place to be.
A pleased little ripple travels from Vaporeon's nose to tail.
Vaporeon stretches toward your hand as if this was always the plan.
The official comfort level has increased noticeably.
Vaporeon gives you a look that means: yes, continue.
Vaporeon is now carrying a small amount of extra happy.

boop_accept.text: The boop receives a passing grade from the aquatic committee.
Vaporeon boops back with precisely calibrated politeness.
A single approving blink confirms the boop was accepted.
Vaporeon records this under friendly nonsense.
The official boop ledger has been updated.

boop_offended.text: Vaporeon has entered a brief period of dramatic reflection.
One ear lowers. The complaint is tiny but sincere.
Vaporeon pretends not to care for exactly three seconds.
The boop has caused a minor disturbance in the dignity department.
A tiny legal notice has appeared in the nearest puddle.

boop_splash.text: A retaliatory droplet lands with unreasonable precision.
Vaporeon has activated the tiny revenge fountain.
The boop is returned with interest, payable in water.
A smug little tail swish confirms the counter-boop was intentional.
The consequences arrive in one extremely cold drop.

boop_neutral.text: The boop exists. Vaporeon has no further comment.
A neutral ripple is issued for administrative purposes.
Vaporeon assigns the boop a perfectly average score.

feed.text: Vaporeon finishes the snack, then looks at the empty spot with optimism.
Vaporeon approves of the snack's texture, vibe, and quantity.
The snack was excellent. Vaporeon will remember this during future negotiations.
Vaporeon performs a tiny post-snack stretch.
The pantry has gained Vaporeon's respectful attention.

hug.text: Vaporeon presses close in the way only a very trusted water creature can.
A calm little wave settles around the hug.
Vaporeon decides this hug deserves a longer hold.
The world becomes briefly quieter and more blanket-shaped.
A cool fin squeeze says you are safe here.

splash.text: Vaporeon gives the water a tiny flourish before sending it onward.
The splash arrives with the confidence of a very small storm.
Vaporeon has added a completely unnecessary but excellent spin.
The water has been launched with ceremonial precision.

splash_effect.text: The water finds its mark with suspicious narrative timing.
A single drop lands somewhere emotionally significant.
The target has been inconvenienced by moisture.
Vaporeon considers the splash result highly educational.
The target's dry-vibe defenses have suffered a setback.

photo.text: Vaporeon found a photo with extremely respectable ears.
This image has passed the puddle committee's visual inspection.
Vaporeon selected a picture that feels like a small good day.
The album has released another carefully curated splash.
Vaporeon requests that you admire the composition for at least four seconds.

choose.text: Vaporeon has consulted a pebble and received a decisive answer.
The answer surfaced after one exceptionally dramatic ripple.
Vaporeon selected the option with the best blanket compatibility.
A tiny splash has underlined this choice for emphasis.

rate_low.text: Vaporeon gives it a concerned little fin tap.
It may need more cozy and at least one berry.
The aquatic committee has requested revisions.
Vaporeon thinks it could be rescued by a nap.

rate_mid.text: A good foundation. Add a snack and reassess.
Vaporeon gives it one thoughtful, approving ripple.
It has earned a place near the middle of the blanket.

rate_high.text: Vaporeon has promoted this to extremely commendable.
This earns a joyful tail swish and a very high rating.
The puddle council is standing in applause.
Vaporeon would save this for a rainy day.
